answer_1.quote: CODEXGRAPH ... enables repository-level code generation ... across three challenging and representative repository-level benchmarks: CrossCodeEval, SWE‑bench and EvoCodeBench.
answer_1.outputs: generated code snippets, patches, comments, and unit tests

answer_2.quote: We measure performance with code match and identifier match metrics, assessing accuracy with exact match (EM), edit similarity (ES), and F1 scores ... SWE‑bench utilizes % Resolved (Pass@1) ... EvoCodeBench employs Pass@k and Recall@k.
